notes: Cigarettes provide 98.2% of revenue, so tobacco is the core business. The workforce fell from 30,308 to 21,964 through an early retirement programme in 2025; employee training continued 'in line with current needs'. CSR spend rose from Rp 29.4bn (2023) to Rp 212.8bn (2025), but no breakdown by programme is given. The itemized activities are mostly small local event sponsorships and donations, so the Community level 3 rests on the aggregate dollar figure. Kelud Vespa Day falls under a government MSME and Tourism programme, but the company only took part in the event; this is not counted as enabling entrepreneurship. Subsidiary PT Graha Surya Media is described only as 'entertainment services', with no detail, so it is not scored. Coal-free, but the business includes airport and toll-road concessions.
